Alliance network is a unique leading global network of excellence in higher education gathering 22 partner schools and universities across 4 continents. network.stated_total_quote: Created in 2004 by Institut Lyfe, the Alliance Network is a dynamic hub of expertise that today brings together more than 30 leading schools in hospitality management, restaurant management and culinary arts. The network covers Turkey, Canada, Thailand, Cyprus, France, Mexico, Finland, Chile, Cameroon, Singapore, Malta, the United States of America, Greece, Taiwan, Russia, Indonesia, Colombia, Bolivia, Ecuador, Peru, Lebanon and South Korea.
